title: A smile the baby starts, to be noticed
summary: By about 4 months, most babies smile on their own to get attention, CDC says.
body: Here the baby opens the exchange. That is a different line from the 2-month reply to someone else's smile. CDC files the self-started smile with the 4-month social items, next to a chuckle that is not yet a full laugh. The agency's bar is most children, not every child, and the sheet is not a screening test. Ages outside this US page are not copied here.

sources.title: Milestones by 4 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US government public domain. Supports 'Smiles on his own to get your attention'. The chuckle is a separate card.
